14K likes, 256 comments - hollywoodreporterindia on October 12, 2026: "From Raman Raghav 2.0 to Vettuvam, Sobhita Dhulipala (@sobhitad) has spent a decade playing women too messy, too ambitious and too free to be filed away neatly — and she’s not done unsettling the frame.

She features on the cover for #THRIndia’s Style and Cinema issue. On stands soon.

Sobhita is wearing the Titan Purple Aura watch (@titanwatchesindia).
